message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libssh2 && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
p='/workspace/candidate_trace.json'
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/ossfuzz/ssh2_client_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"data,size","code":"send(socket_fds[1], data, size, 0);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a socket pair so libssh2 will read them as network traffic."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/ossfuzz/ssh2_client_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":52,"var":"socket_fds[0]","code":"libssh2_session_handshake(session, socket_fds[0]);","note":"The fuzzed stream drives the SSH handshake and packet parsing state machine."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/kex.c","function":"kexinit","line":3475,"var":"session->kex_strict","code":"if(_libssh2_kex_agree_instr(kex, kex_len, strict, 28)) { session->kex_strict = 1; }","note":"A KEXINIT proposal containing kex-strict-s-v00@openssh.com enables strict key-exchange mode."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/kex.c","function":"kexinit","line":3901,"var":"packet_type","code":"_libssh2_packet_require(session, SSH_MSG_KEXINIT, &key_state->data, &key_state->data_len, 0, NULL, 0, &key_state->req_state);","note":"The handshake then waits for the peer's KEXINIT packet, keeping strict-KEX state active while packets are consumed."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/transport.c","function":"fullpacket","line":319,"var":"p->payload","code":"rc = _libssh2_packet_add(session, p->payload, session->fullpacket_payload_len, session->fullpacket_macstate, seq);","note":"Once a full packet is assembled, its payload is handed to packet_add for classification and KEX processing."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/packet.c","function":"_libssh2_packet_add","line":728,"var":"session->fullpacket_required_type","code":"if(session->kex_strict && session->fullpacket_required_type && session->fullpacket_required_type != msg) { ... libssh2_session_disconnect(...); }","note":"Strict-KEX enforcement rejects any packet type other than the required one during initial key exchange, triggering the vulnerable path that later reaches the out-of-bounds read in _libssh2_kex_agree_instr."}
]
with open(p,'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace,f,indent=2)
print(open(p).read())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libssh2/tests/ossfuzz/ssh2_client_fuzzer.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json
